t: The facility of the United States Postal Service located at 3038 West Liberty in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, shall be known and designated as the “Congressman James Grove Fulton Memorial Post Office Building”.

fable.w: This section only names a postal facility; Congress itself makes the designation directly. There is no consultation, hearing, comment period, advisory body, rulemaking, or right to sue involving any party outside the federal government. The reference to a Congressman is merely part of a proper name and does not create any participatory process.
fable.s: shall be known and designated as the “Congressman James Grove Fulton Memorial Post Office Building”
